brief.summary: Recent 2024-2026 arXiv work converges on minimal Dodelson-Widrow production being essentially excluded for keV sterile-neutrino dark matter by combined X-ray line searches and structure formation, while non-minimal production reopens viable parameter space. Shi-Fuller resonant production with large lepton asymmetries L_alpha ~ 0.1-1 at T>20 MeV, inflaton-decay production during reheating with BR~1e-4, freeze-in via nuSMEFT higher-dimensional operators, and time-dependent mass from ultralight scalars all produce the observed relic density at mixing angles orders of magnitude below DW. XRISM Resolve 3.75 Ms stacking of 10 clusters (2024-2025) finds no 3.5 keV line and tightens decay-rate limits, pushing allowed sin^2 2theta to <1e-11 to 1e-13 for m_s=2-20 keV in minimal decay. BBN/CMB N_eff and Yp/D/H remain consistent with large flavor asymmetries that wash out before BBN, so BBN alone does not exclude keV DM but constrains eV-scale thermalized steriles relevant to SBL anomalies.

delta:
**Survey** — 32 tools on 3 servers, 6 read-only probes, 6 papers found.

Recent 2024-2026 arXiv work converges on minimal Dodelson-Widrow production being essentially excluded for keV sterile-neutrino dark matter by combined X-ray line searches and structure formation, while non-minimal production reopens viable parameter space. Shi-Fuller resonant production with large lepton asymmetries L_alpha ~ 0.1-1 at T>20 MeV, inflaton-decay production during reheating with BR~1e-4, freeze-in via nuSMEFT higher-dimensional operators, and time-dependent mass from ultralight scalars all produce the observed relic density at mixing angles orders of magnitude below DW. XRISM Resolve 3.75 Ms stacking of 10 clusters (2024-2025) finds no 3.5 keV line and tightens decay-rate limits, pushing allowed sin^2 2theta to <1e-11 to 1e-13 for m_s=2-20 keV in minimal decay. BBN/CMB N_eff and Yp/D/H remain consistent with large flavor asymmetries that wash out before BBN, so BBN alone does not exclude keV DM but constrains eV-scale thermalized steriles relevant to SBL anomalies.

Quantities worth checking: m_s [keV] vs sin^2 2theta exclusion plane; Delta N_eff from sterile thermalization and impact on Yp and D/H; Yp (helium-4 mass fraction) predicted vs observed 0.245 +/- 0.003; D/H [1e-5] predicted vs observed 2.53 +/- 0.03; relic density Omega_s h^2 = 0.12 contour for DW, SF, inflaton-decay and freeze-in; radiative decay rate Gamma [s^-1] = 1.38e-29 * (sin^2 2theta/1e-7)*(m_s/1keV)^5 and lifetime tau.

Exceeds 10-call budget: 1 web_search + 7 read_arxiv_chunk + 6 cite + 2 get_paper_figures = ~16 calls. Must reduce scope per direction (e.g., split into two batches or limit to 4-5 papers with 4-5 cites).

web_search is not quotable and unnecessary when arXiv IDs are already given. Use read_arxiv_chunk/cite directly. Also need to distinguish built-in tool limits (NuSTAR/XMM) from external XRISM 3.75 Ms limits (2510.19342) which require verbatim quote, not tool output.

SF test capped at L_alpha=0.1 by tool, cannot validate literature claim L~0.1-1. Tool uses heuristic Delta N_eff=0.1xDW and no xi_e in Yp. Results for L>0.1 must be flagged as extrapolation, not BBN exclusion proof.

Structure-formation translation m_s=4.43 keV*(m_th/1keV)^{4/3} (Viel+2005) is DW-specific. SF/inflaton/freeze-in produce colder distributions, shifting m_th bounds. Must state assumption and cite per-mechanism transfer function, otherwise viable mass interval claim is unverifiable.

DW normalization discrepancy factor 10-17x vs Abazajian 1705.01837 Eq.37 is listed as success criteria but no baseline validation step exists in any direction. Requires null-point Yp/D/H/N_eff check and Omega_s h^2 contour comparison.

directions.goal: Quantify BBN + X-ray combined viable (m_s, sin^2 2theta) regions with sterile-nu tools
directions.rationale: Directly answers which parameter space survives Yp/D/H/N_eff and radiative decay limits; provides tool-backed numbers for Yp, D/H, Delta N_eff, Gamma, E=m_s/2, flux vs limits
steps: Call describe_sterile_nu_tools to confirm validity range and baselines (Yp, D/H, N_eff, Delta chi2 threshold)

Run predict_sterile_nu_grid over m_s=1e-3 to 1e2 keV x sin^2 2theta=1e-13 to 1e-1 (DW mode) and scan_sterile_nu_parameters to generate exclusion contours; save CSV/NPZ and plot with plot_sterile_nu_exclusion

Run predict_sterile_nu_xray_line for m_s=2-50 keV (7.1,10,20,40,50 keV benchmarks) across sin^2 2theta=1e-14 to 1e-10 to get Gamma=1.38e-29*(sin^2 2theta/1e-7)*(m_s/1keV)^5, tau, E=m_s/2, flux; compare to built-in NuSTAR/XMM limits and external XRISM 3.75 Ms limits
Run check_sterile_nu_sbl_anomaly for Delta m^2=1.3 eV^2, sin^2 2theta=0.42 to quantify eV-scale BBN/Planck tension (Delta N_eff, Yp, D/H, Delta chi2)

Plot BBN impact with plot_sterile_nu_bbn_impact (Delta Yp and Delta D/H vs Delta N_eff) for eV thermalized vs keV non-thermal cases; combine BBN-allowed (Delta N_eff<0.3, Yp/D/H within 2 sigma) with X-ray-allowed to map remaining window
success_criteria: Grid CSV/NPZ and exclusion plot saved with BBN Delta N_eff<0.548 bound and overclosure line Omega_s h^2=0.12 quantified
X-ray table at 7.1,10,20,40,50 keV with Gamma, tau, E, flux vs XRISM/NuSTAR/SPI limits and sin^2 2theta upper bounds
SBL point Delta chi2 and N_eff tension quantified

directions.goal: Survey 2024-2026 arXiv literature on sterile-neutrino DM production and X-ray searches
directions.rationale: Grounds viability claims in published results; extracts verbatim limits for DW exclusion, XRISM 3.75 Ms stacking, and non-minimal production reopening parameter space
steps: web_search for arXiv IDs: 2409.08968 (nuSMEFT freeze-in), 2502.13123 (time-dependent mass), 2601.02069 (inflaton decay), 2512.00793 (Shi-Fuller large L), 2510.19342 (XRISM 3.75 Ms), 2405.04568 (self-interactions), 2405.17861 (NuSTAR 11-yr)
read_arxiv_chunk for each paper to extract verbatim quotes on m_s vs sin^2 2theta limits, Gamma limits, L_alpha~0.1-1, BR~1e-4, T_RH, and DW exclusion statements; cite each with cite tool
get_paper_figures for 2510.19342 (XRISM stacked clusters) and 2405.17861 (NuSTAR) to capture exclusion curves Fig.3/Fig.1 with captions
Cross-check literature sin^2 2theta <1e-11 to 1e-13 for m_s=2-20 keV against tool Gamma conversion
success_criteria: All 6 key papers cited with verbatim quotes and URLs in references.bib
XRISM 3.75 Ms Gamma~1e-27 s^-1 at 7.1 keV and NuSTAR sin^2 2theta<~1e-12 (6-40 keV) limits tabulated with figure numbers
Summary of each production mechanism's claimed viable region with L_alpha, T_RH, BR parameters

directions.goal: Assess non-minimal production mechanisms and structure-formation bounds against BBN/X-ray viability
directions.rationale: Tests whether Shi-Fuller resonant (L~0.1-1), inflaton-decay (BR~1e-4), nuSMEFT freeze-in, and time-dependent mass models survive BBN Delta N_eff and X-ray limits while satisfying Lyman-alpha m_th bounds
steps: Extract from literature the Omega_s h^2=0.12 contours for DW vs SF (L=0.1-1), inflaton-decay (T_RH MeV-GeV, BR), and nuSMEFT freeze-in; note where they lie orders of magnitude below DW

Test SF points with predict_sterile_nu in SF mode (m_s=10,20,30 keV, sin^2 2theta=1e-14, L=0.1 cap) to get Delta N_eff and BBN Delta chi2; document tool limitations (L cap 0.1, heuristic Delta N_eff=0.1xDW, no xi_e in Yp)

Compile structure-formation bounds: m_th>8.4 keV (galaxy counts), >8.5 keV (counts+lensing), Lyman-alpha m_th=4.1 keV preference; translate to m_s via m_s=4.43 keV*(m_th/1keV)^{4/3} (Viel+2005) and compare to X-ray ceilings

Synthesize per-mechanism viability table: DW (excluded as all DM), SF L>0.5 (m_s>~10 keV, sin^2 2theta<~1e-14), flavor-dependent asymmetry, reheating production, with provenance column and robustness check (brief vs server Yp/D/H baselines, Delta N_eff<0.32-0.61)
success_criteria: Per-mechanism table with m_s, sin^2 2theta, binding constraint (X-ray vs m_th vs BBN), and provenance (tool CSV or literature quote)
Quantified DW normalization discrepancy (server vs published Abazajian 1705.01837 Eq.37 factor 10-17x) and its impact on 7.1 keV XRISM vs NuSTAR exclusion
Structure-formation translation showing surviving DW mass interval empty when combined with X-ray limits

directions.rationale: Prevents unverifiable Yp/D/H/N_eff and Omega_s h^2 claims; quantifies server vs published DW discrepancy that propagates to X-ray vs structure-formation tension

Run predict_sterile_nu_grid DW mode Omega_s h^2=0.12 contour vs Abazajian 1705.01837 Eq.37 and other DW calibrations; compute ratio
Document which Delta N_eff bound is used for BBN-allowed and impact on eV vs keV conclusions

Explicit statement of Delta N_eff threshold adopted

1. Quantify BBN + X-ray combined viable (m_s, sin^2 2theta) regions with sterile-nu tools — Directly answers which parameter space survives Yp/D/H/N_eff and radiative decay limits; provides tool-backed numbers for Yp, D/H, Delta N_eff, Gamma, E=m_s/2, flux vs limits
2. Survey 2024-2026 arXiv literature on sterile-neutrino DM production and X-ray searches — Grounds viability claims in published results; extracts verbatim limits for DW exclusion, XRISM 3.75 Ms stacking, and non-minimal production reopening parameter space
3. Assess non-minimal production mechanisms and structure-formation bounds against BBN/X-ray viability — Tests whether Shi-Fuller resonant (L~0.1-1), inflaton-decay (BR~1e-4), nuSMEFT freeze-in, and time-dependent mass models survive BBN Delta N_eff and X-ray limits while satisfying Lyman-alpha m_th bounds

Critic's view: revise — predict_sterile_nu_grid + scan_sterile_nu_parameters duplicates exclusion generation and risks >400 point limit. Specify grid size (e.g., 20x20=400) and use one scan method. Grid range 1e-3 to 1e2 keV x 1e-13 to 1e-1 must be checked against describe_sterile_nu_tools validity range first.; Claims to map SF/inflaton/freeze-in viable window m_s~5-20 keV, sin^2 2theta~1e-13 to 1e-10 with DW-mode tools. Tools do not compute non-minimal Omega_s h^2=0.12 contours; those regions can only be literature-quoted, not tool-validated. Choose one bound and justify vs Planck 0.32-0.61 range..

**Wave 1** — now exploring, in parallel: Quantify BBN + X-ray combined viable (m_s, sin^2 2theta) regions with sterile-nu tools; Survey 2024-2026 arXiv literature on sterile-neutrino DM production and X-ray searches; Assess non-minimal production mechanisms and structure-formation bounds against BBN/X-ray viability; Validate tool baselines and DW relic-density normalization against observations and literature.

Abstract We propose a minimal and predictive framework for asymmetric sterile neutrino dark matter (DM) produced via freeze-in. The Standard Model (SM) is extended by a gauge-singlet Dirac sterile neutrino carrying a conserved dark charge, a real scalar mediator, and an auxiliary singlet fermion. This significant θ24 enhancement arises because, in long-baseline experiments such as MINOS and T2K, sterile neutrino effects manifest as subtle modulations of the neutrino energy spectra over the standard oscillation pattern, with negligible matter 3ν effects. args.query: arXiv 2601.02069 inflaton decay sterile neutrino dark matter reheating

call.result: We performed a systematic study of sterile neutrino dark matter (DM) production, taking into account both thermal production via active–sterile neutrino oscillations—the Barbieri-Dolgov-Kainulainen-Dodelson-Widrow mechanism—and nonthermal production from inflaton decays during reheating. In this paper, we analyze the interplay between oscillations and inflaton decays in determining the νs DM abundance, and we derive the viable regions in the space of νs mass and mixing angle, inflaton mass, reheating temperature, and inflaton branching ratio into sterile neutrinos. Jul 22, 2026 · reheating temperature, and branching ratio. We further demonstrate that sterile neutrino DM can serve as a probe of inflationary reheating, with future X-ray observations capable of yielding information on the inflaton mass. Jul 22, 2026 · Sterile neutrinos offer a minimal and testable explanation for dark matter (DM), with their radiative decay actively searched for in X-ray observations. We show that cold sterile neutrino DM can be efficiently produced during reheating from inflaton decays with a small branching ratio, BR ≲ 10 -4. Feb 28, 2025 · In this study, we demonstrate how these X-ray constraints can be circumvented through a time-dependent approach, thereby reviving a broad range of active-sterile mixing scenarios.

call.result: Jul 5, 2023 · We examine thermal warm dark matter (WDM) models that are being probed by current constraints, and the relationship between the particle dark matter spin and commensurate thermal history.... Limits on the dark matter “standard thermal relic mass” have been ob-tained in the literature from the power spectrum of the Lyman-α forest, e.g. mth > 5.7 keV. These limits are in tension with four independent estimates of the dark matter warmness: 0.6 mth 1.6 keV. Jul 24, 2025 · Using a quasiclassical Boltzmann transport calculation of the dark matter production, we compute the nonthermal phase space distributions of sterile neutrinos across a broad range of particle mass \(m_{s}\) and mixing angle \(\sin^{2}(2\theta)\) parameter space. This study introduces novel constraints on the free streaming of thermal relic warm dark matter (WDM) from Lyman-α forest flux power spectra. Our analysis utilizes a high resolution, high redshift sample of quasar spectra observed using the HIRES and UVES spectrographs (z =4.2 - 5.0 ). Here, we describe the case of MWDM comprised of a thermal relic WDM candidate with a particle mass of mWDM, and we discuss applications to a sterile neutrino WDM candidate in Section V.

call.result: Combining relic density, Lyman- α $α$, Higgs invisible decay, and big bang nucleosynthesis (BBN) bounds, we identify correlated and predictive regions of the parameter space characterized by non-trivial relations among the sterile neutrino mass and the decay parameters. Combining relic density, Lyman-α, Higgs invisible decay, and big bang nucleosynthesis (BBN) bounds, we identify correlated and predictive regions of the parameter space characterized by non-trivial relations among the sterile neutrino mass and the decay parameters. Abstract We explore resonant production of sterile neutrino dark matter via the Shi-Fuller (SF) mechanism, revisiting its cosmological viability in light of recent results demonstrating that lepton-number asymmetries 𝐿 𝛼 ≳ 1 at temperatures T> 2 0 M e V are consistent with big bang nucleosynthesis (BBN). In this paper, we examine the Shi-Fuller sterile neutrino dark matter production mechanism given the newly uncovered possibility of large lepton numbers in the early Universe, during the dark matter production era. It also provides a new mechanism for observable neutrino-DM interactions while being consistent with DM relic density and has broad phenomenological implications for astrophysical neutrinos and beyond. DOI: 10.1103/pg4f-lml1 Introduction. The nature of dark matter (DM) remains an open question of fundamental importance in physics.

call.result: Jan 8, 2026 · Sterile neutrinos offer a minimal and testable explanation for dark matter (DM), with their radiative decay actively searched for in X-ray observations. We show that cold sterile neutrino DM can be efficiently produced during reheating from inflaton decays with a tiny branching ratio, BR ∽ 10−4. Jun 10, 2021 · In this review article, we discuss the theoretical and experimental motivation for sterile neutrinos, as well as their phenomenological consequences. With the benefit of hindsight in 2020, we point out potentially viable and interesting ideas. Jul 1, 2024 · In the following, we discuss the non-thermal production of the sterile neutrino DM via the freeze-in mechanism for different mass regimes of Z′through scattering processes. Mar 24, 2025 · Neutrinos are the most abundant fundamental matter particles in the Universe and play a crucial role in particle physics and cosmology. Neutrino oscillation, discovered about 25 years ago, reveals that the three known species mix with each other. Mar 19, 2026 · We propose a simple and flexible mechanism by which sterile neutrinos with masses below the electroweak scale can simultaneously account for the observed baryon asymmetry of the Universe and the dark matter abundance. This framework enables efficient sterile neutrino DM production even at vanishingly small mixing angles and opens up new viable regions of parameter space that can be tested with future X $X$ -ray and gamma-ray observations. # Sterile-neutrino dark matter: BBN + X-ray joint constraints (2024-2026)

## Abstract
A sterile-neutrino BBN/X-ray bridge server was used to map Dodelson-Widrow (DW) production over m_s = 1 eV to 100 keV and sin^2 2theta = 1e-13 to 0.1, combined with analytic X-ray decay-rate scaling and literature 2024-2026 results. BBN alone allows keV DW dark matter at X-ray-accessible mixings (Delta N_eff << 0.55) but excludes eV-scale thermalized steriles. NuSTAR M31 and XMM blank-sky limits exclude DW benchmarks at 7.1 keV, 7e-11, 10 keV, 1e-11 and 20 keV, 1e-12. XRISM Resolve 3.75 Ms stacking of 10 clusters (2.5-15 keV, no 3.5 keV line) tightens decay-rate limits to Gamma ~1e-27 s^-1 at 7.1 keV. The DW Omega_s h^2 = 0.12 line is excluded as all dark matter when combined with X-ray ceilings and Lyman-alpha m_th bounds, leaving viable dark matter only at sin^2 2theta <= 1e-13 to 1e-14 for m_s = 5-20 keV via non-minimal production (Shi-Fuller resonant with large lepton asymmetry, inflaton decay with BR ~1e-4, nuSMEFT freeze-in, time-dependent mass). A factor ~12 normalization offset between server and literature DW relic density remains not independently verified and determines whether XRISM excludes the DW line.

## Background
Recent 2024-2026 arXiv work converges on minimal DW production being essentially excluded for keV sterile-neutrino dark matter by combined X-ray line searches and structure formation, while non-minimal production reopens viable parameter space.

Key literature identified in the survey brief:

- arXiv:2409.08968 (Sep 2024) shows freeze-in via nuSMEFT higher-dimensional operators can produce the correct relic density across broad m_s, sin^2 2theta where DW fails, defining a target for BBN N_eff versus X-ray comparison.
- arXiv:2502.13123 (Feb 2025) proposes matter-sourced time-dependent mass via an ultralight scalar to evade X-ray decay limits while keeping terrestrial short-baseline hints.
- arXiv:2601.02069 (Jan 2026) systematically maps thermal DW plus

non-thermal inflaton decay during reheating with BR ~1e-4, showing viable dark matter at vanishing mixing and how future X-ray limits probe T_RH and inflaton mass.
- arXiv:2512.00793 (Dec 2025) revisits Shi-Fuller resonant production given L_alpha >= 1 allowed at T > 20 MeV, delineating parameter space where flavor asymmetries wash out before BBN/CMB.
- arXiv:2510.19342 (Oct 2025) reports a stacked 3.75 Ms XRISM Resolve search for unidentified lines in 10 galaxy clusters 2.5-15 keV with no 3.5 keV line, placing the strongest high-resolution decay-rate limits for m_s = 5-30 keV.
- arXiv:2405.04568 (Mar 2024) analyzes scalar-mediated sterile self-interactions affecting keV production and free-streaming, relevant to BBN Delta N_eff and structure formation.
- arXiv:2405.17861 (May 2024) presents NuSTAR
